skillNames: visual draft labels only; no official CMS skills or balance assigned

specs.name: 빙결 저격
specs.detail: A precise ice sniper skill: electric cyan with tiny magenta accents echoing the sniper rifle, crystalline frost flecks, narrow needle-like ice tracer. Charge is a tight cold concentric glint with snow crystals. Discharge is a SMALL narrow muzzle bloom followed by a thin straight cyan/magenta needle tracer pointing right; not a massive cannon laser. Impact is a sharp asymmetric star of fractured translucent ice with individual shards followed by evaporating frost. Clean, fast, surgical snow-sniper identity.
specs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE production 2D transparent VFX sprite sheet for a single fantasy-game skill.
Canvas: landscape 4:3 ratio, preferably 2048 x 1536. Precisely 4 COLUMNS and 3 ROWS of equal SQUARE CELLS, 12 separate chronological painted frames. All 12 cells are entirely invisible guides: NO visible grid, NO labels, NO numbers, NO boxes, NO text, NO weapon, NO character, NO scenery.
Each cell has 12% transparent padding; NOTHING touches or crosses into an adjacent cell. Use a GENUINELY transparent RGBA background, with clean alpha on smoke/filaments, no black/gray rectangle.
ROW 1: four frames of charging at the EXACT CENTER of each cell, from a tiny seed, to gathering filaments, to compact focused charge, to peak charge.
ROW 2: four discharge/projectile frames. The emission/leftmost solid-effect point stays at 15% of cell width, exact vertical midpoint. All projectiles and jets point perfectly HORIZONTALLY RIGHT along y=50%, reaching at most 86% width. Each frame is newly painted with actual evolving shape, not repeated copy transformed or recolored. Entire trail remains in the cell, no backward trails beyond x=12%.
ROW 3: four impact frames at the EXACT CENTER: initial contact, strong maximal break/bloom, separated dispersing fragments, sparse terminal afterglow. Dramatically diminishing material in the last cell.
Polished painterly luminous fantasy-game sprites with very clear silhouette, varied density and visible transparent gaps, layered narrow highlights and individual shards; never opaque clouds or white rectangles. No cast shadows. No watermark. This is a coherent temporal animation sheet, not 12 unrelated skill icons.

specs.name: 청광 레일포
specs.detail: An enormous expanded-rail laser-cannon skill: saturated electric cyan, brilliant blue-white core, angular electric filaments and a structured magnetic compression ring. Charge is a compact rotating four-lobed electromagnetic corona that visibly concentrates. Discharge is a forceful STRAIGHT horizontal cyan-white laser beam, sharp parallel outer streaks, starting from a tight source aperture at the LEFT and projecting RIGHT with a pointed terminal; the upper and lower beam edges are straight. Impact is a large blue-white electrical rupture with angular blue shards and cyan plasma arcs, later breaking into distinct sparks. Mechanical heavy-weapon identity, no generic fireball.

specs.name: 자수정 나선
specs.detail: Violet spiral sorcery matching a black-haired fox-eared sorceress. Rich violet and pale lilac with a white-violet core. Charge is interlocking fine elliptical violet filaments condensing into a spiral orb. Discharge is a compact twisting spiral comet traveling horizontally to the RIGHT, four different hand-drawn internal swirl structures and delicate curved tail filaments. Impact is an irregular violet space-tear with sharp dark-violet glass-like facets and fine astral dust; the core opens then closes, leaving a delicate crescent of sparks. Keep clear holes and transparent negative spaces; not an opaque purple smoke blob.

specs.name: 황금 석궁
specs.detail: Regal burgundy-and-gold musketeer crossbow skill. Charge is a delicate gold filigree aiming glint with burgundy/red gemstone particles. Discharge is ONE perfectly straight silver-gold arrow bolt flying horizontally RIGHT with sharp arrowhead and a golden feather-shaped wake, no gun, no laser, no duck or hand. Four flight frames have real changes in the wake and sparks while the rigid projectile itself stays straight and identical in design. Impact is a sharp golden puncture flash fanning into small metallic feather-like gilded shards with small burgundy rose-red glints, then separating and fading. Elegant crossbow projectile, not explosive fire.

specs.name: 월광 결정
specs.detail: Moon-crystal sorcery for an elegant white/gold crystal-staff mage. Moonlight ice-blue, silver-white, restrained warm pale-gold filigree. Charge is a small star-shaped crystal emerging inside delicate moon arcs. Discharge is a luminous diamond-shaped BLUE CRYSTAL flying horizontally to the RIGHT with a fine white-gold curved comet trail and little blue crystals, four distinct trail/spark silhouettes. Impact is a graceful expanding flower of faceted blue crystal petals and elegant gold crescent arcs; after blooming its separated shards dissolve into fine star dust. Radiant refined crystal magic, not a gun burst, not a generic blue explosion.
